text:
We talk a lot about cloud storage and redundant hard drives, but we rarely discuss the accessibility blind spot in digital photo backups: the metadata barrier. 

Many backup workflows rely heavily on visual scanning to organize files. For users with visual impairments, a folder full of "IMG_4829.jpg" files is a digital graveyard. Without a disciplined habit of adding descriptive alt-text or semantic file naming during the backup process, your most precious memories become functionally invisible and impossible to navigate.
